task: RoomAI Phase 6 — Audit A3 Evaluation, Fix Metric Inconsistencies, and Verify Deployment
auditor: Senior Computer Vision Engineer & ML Evaluation Auditor

environment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (8,188 MiB)

baseline_a2_finetune.defect_identified: Erroneous hash string documented in reports/indoor_data_error_analysis.md (3a4294ca2373fb3eaefbbf55e37a3c3c vs actual ad899be666950b695c825a2e57229a58). Actual file has not been modified.

baseline_a2_pilot.role: Parent pre-finetune pilot checkpoint used as initialization weights for both A2 finetune and A3 800px training.

evaluation_methodology_audit.map_computation_protocol: Standard COCO 101-point PR interpolation across confidence sweep and IoU thresholds [0.50:0.05:0.95] via Ultralytics val(conf=0.001, iou=0.70). Confirmed not a single confidence operating point.
evaluation_methodology_audit.precision_recall_f1_definition: Extracted at max-F1 peak of the smoothed F1-confidence curve across 1,000 bins in Ultralytics DetMetrics, harmonic mean calculated as 2*P*R/(P+R+1e-6).

class_averaging_and_window_audit.audit_finding: The window class has zero ground-truth bounding boxes in the test split. Ultralytics properly omits window from ap_class_index, meaning the test mAP50 of 0.7464 (A2) and 0.7760 (A3) is the mean over the 11 classes present in ground truth. However, reports/indoor_a3_800px_eval.json explicitly output precision: 0.0, recall: 0.0, mAP50: 0.0. This is corrected to reflect window as UNEVALUABLE on the test split rather than zero performance.

evaluation_methodology_audit.dataset_split_parity: Verified identical 2,985 train, 554 val, 150 test images across data/indoor_canonical, identical letterbox preprocessing, identical seed 42.

operating_point_resolution.root_cause_of_identical_ops: tune_indoor_thresholds.py logged res.box.mp and res.box.mr which in Ultralytics DetMetrics return the global max-F1 curve peak values rather than metrics at the evaluated threshold, and CONF_RANGE stopped at 0.15, causing both best_f1 and high_recall selectors to pick the same entry.
operating_point_resolution.selection_rule: Operating points selected strictly on the unaugmented validation split curve (1,000 threshold bins). Balanced F1 selected at max F1. High Precision selected at max Precision with Recall >= 0.55. High Recall selected at max Recall with Precision >= 0.60.

reused_test_set_evaluations.note: Evaluated on the existing held-out test split for diagnostic comparison. Clearly labeled as a reused test split; no test information was used during threshold selection.

operating_point_resolution.f1_discrepancy_explanation: The overall test F1 of 0.7438 is computed from standard model.val() PR curve peak (P=0.8301, R=0.6738 across continuous curve). The operating-point F1 of 0.7498 previously reported was from a discrete evaluation at conf=0.15, iou=0.50 where lower-confidence detections boosted recall to 0.6937 with precision 0.8157. Under the rigorous validation-selected operating point (conf=0.3654), test F1 is 0.7384.

fair_latency_benchmark.hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (8,188 MiB)
fair_latency_benchmark.protocol: Pre-warmed GPU and cuDNN (50 warmup iterations), 30 model warmup iterations, 100 timed iterations with torch.cuda.synchronize()
fair_latency_benchmark.audit_verdict_latency: The Phase 5 reported latency (A2 at 20.84ms vs A3 at 10.87ms) was an artifact of cold-start benchmarking on A2. Under fair pre-warmed conditions, A3 (800px) incurs only +0.52ms pipeline overhead over A2 (640px) (13.57ms vs 13.05ms), both operating easily above 73 FPS with minimal VRAM footprint.

application_integration_audit.candidate_status: A3 is currently a verified candidate checkpoint on disk, NOT active in model_config.yaml or ModelRegistry.
application_integration_audit.mock_mode_and_fallbacks: VERIFIED_FUNCTIONAL (MockObjectDetector returns valid synthetic responses; fallback to A1 and DeepFurniture intact).

audit_decision.summary_rationale: All evaluation and metric reporting anomalies have been resolved and documented. A3 demonstrates genuine, reproducible gains (+2.96% mAP50, +5.88% mAP50-95, +10.01% chair/stool mAP50), fair benchmarking confirms negligible latency impact (13.57ms vs 13.05ms, >73 FPS), all 77 tests pass, and A2 remains intact for zero-downtime rollback.
